question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Individuals**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Individuals **refer to single human beings; people, considered separately rather than collectively. (व्यक्तियों)

 
 
• **Example**: *In the survey, individuals were asked to express their opinions on the proposed changes.*
 
 
 
• I
